Context: SMB support SaaS building an in-app AI assistant (support-agent). Came in via self-serve; heavy interest in streaming responses + tool-calling to integrate ticket search + KB lookups.

Symptoms observed:
- When using JSON mode + streaming, the client sometimes receives truncated JSON chunk or a closing brace missing. Parsing failure in client library.
- Function call mode: customer-defined function schema (searchTicket) contains optional/required mismatch vs runtime output (eg: external_id sometimes null but schema typed string => validation error).
- Example error from frontend: "Unexpected token } in JSON at position 1024" during stream end.
- Customer is using Node SDK with stream parser on the client; they reused an older function signature after schema change.

What we tried:
- Walked through sample payloads on call (2026-02-22). Demonstrated deterministic streaming with small test prompt.
- SE asked for full logs and raw bytes of stream (customer initially provided parsed logs only).
- SE reproduced schema mismatch locally by changing required properties and saw the same client-side parse exception.

Client priorities / constraints:
- Low-latency chat under 300ms token delivery for interactive UX.
- Cost-sensitive (trial stage) — wants to minimize token waste; interested in batching/streaming to reduce latencies/costs.
- Wants SSO + audit logs for later enterprise commit.

Customer quotes: "We want streaming — but it has to be reliable. If JSON breaks intermittently, we can't ship the feature."
